theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.73%) and Technology (+1.06%) led the market today, while Materials (-1.00%) and Industrials (-0.54%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.05%, defensives -0.26%, and value/cyclicals -0.05% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.11%, Dow +0.02%, Nasdaq -0.27% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -1.22%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 4.00% to 18.18, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 2.43% to $3,883.80, crude oil was little changed at $88.51, and bitcoin slipped 3.29% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
